finding: The existing RECEIPT seal is created as an isolated torus at a fixed position, while WORLD is a separate root object. No visual connector or shared anchor tells an outsider that the receipt belongs to this World snapshot. The manifest supplies a snapshot_id and aggregate counts, but no receipt payload or receipt object to visualize.

candidate_change.operation: Add one deterministic receipt_bridge Line from root.get_center() to seal.get_center(), using the existing receipt color, and Create it immediately before the existing seal animation.
candidate_change.intended_effect: Make the existing RECEIPT seal visibly terminate at the WORLD root, so it reads as the receipt of the rendered read-only snapshot rather than as a detached badge.
candidate_change.data_boundary: Use only existing root/seal geometry. Do not add a receipt id, payload, claim, or other value absent from canonical/world-bound-film-source.v1.json. Keep the seal, RECEIPT label, and source-bound text unchanged.

evidence.observation: WORLD is instantiated as root with a separate root_ring and WORLD label.
RECEIPT is instantiated independently as seal, moved to [0, 0.62, 0], and animated without a relation object to root.
The canonical data contains snapshot_id, aggregate counts, the World/receipt film claim, and fake_evidence=false; it contains no receipt object or receipt payload.
The requested QA artifact was absent at inspection time, so no current-frame, timing, or visual-comprehension claim is made.

falsifier: Reject this candidate if a receipt-beat frame still leaves the seal visually detached from WORLD, or if a blind 2-second comprehension test has fewer than 4 of 5 viewers identify RECEIPT as belonging to the WORLD root. Also reject it if the bridge is read as a worker limb or task orbit, or if it requires any invented receipt data.
